notes.title: OMN now speaks Spanish!
notes.content:
¡Hola a todos!
We extended the language support for One Many Nobody as we've seen many of you willing to play our game, but who wanted to enjoy it in their native Spanish language. :)
We're planning to add more languages throughout the rest of the year, so stay tuned!

The Chestnut Team

notes.title: Added support for Steam Deck D-Pad and minor game improvements
notes.content: We keep listening to our players to improve the overall game experience, thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: One Many Nobody is HERE!
notes.content:
Hi guys!
First of all thanks to all of you who supported us during the development process of One Many Nobody!
During the Steam Next Fest we received some very valuable feedback from people who played the demo that helped us to improve the game even more before the launch. :)
However now things are getting serious! There are 100 levels and over 10h of fun waiting for you (if you're good at this game, otherwise even more hours of playtime!)
If you like this game consider dropping a nice review, we'd much appreciate that. :)
If you run into some issues, have feedback or anything comes into your mind, come on Discord, send us a message on Twitter or open a thread in the discussion board of this game.
With love,

The Chestnut Team

notes.title: Added support for windowed mode!
notes.content: As some of the players requested the feature to be able to switch from fullscreen to windowed mode, we made it happen. :)

notes.title: Play with us during the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
On October 7th at 17:00 (Central European Time) we will be live for one hour while playing One Many Nobody!

notes.title: New feature: the speedrun mode!
notes.content:
Hello guys!
While waiting for the Steam Next Fest and the official launch on October 11th, we just added a new game mode in One Many Nobody: the speedrun!
In this mode you have to complete the game as fast as you can.
We also added some hidden things that you'll need to find in order to complete it even faster...but we're not gonna spoil too much for now!

The Chestnut Team

notes.title: One Many Nobody at the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey guys!
We're happy to announce that we will be part of the Steam Next Fest in October!
You'll be able to play the demo and attending the live streaming events where we will explore this misterious factory and uncover its secrets puzzle after puzzle, all spiced with a bit of thrilling action!
We can't wait to share all of this with you, save the date!

The Chestnut Team

notes.title: Game production is finally complete!
notes.content:
[b]Hoorray![/b]
We're so excited to tell you guys that the production phase of the game is finally over, the game is ready!
It's been about 10 months since the first prototype and we did explore and experiment the cloning mechanic as much as we could, building 100 levels of pure action and fun.
A hard journey at times, but nonetheless really exciting and challenging for us!
There are still few things we are going to do before the official launch in October.
First we will keep polishing every little feature of the game so that what looks good now it will look even better and second we're about to start promoting the game and we can't wait to see how people will react to it!
We'll keep you posted on more updates, stay tuned and enjoy the summer!

notes.title: Gameplay Trailer Released!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We're currently working really hard to finish the third and final chapter of the game, making new levels filled with plenty of action and puzzles. :)
Story is a key element for our games and we're paying attention to every small detail that we hope you'll enjoy when it will be released, on October 2022!
We invite you to wishlist us if you like OMN and we'll keep you posted on how we're progressing towards the launch of the game!
